The main takeaway from our work is that

pumices from a single eruption can have very different petrophysical properties and that these properties are related to the eruptive dynamics and not to their composition or to the magma chamber conditions.
the petrophysical characteristics of pumice can be used to reconstruct the eruptive dynamics in the conduit, and to distinguish the effect of mingling from the effects of shear.
